scope_note: Three selected, established heart-failure guidance documents. This is not an exhaustive or necessarily most recent guideline list; statements need line-by-line recommendation-level extraction before being used for clinical decisions.

guidelines.title: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure
guidelines.summary: Comprehensive U.S. heart failure guideline with HFpEF and HFmrEF treatment sections. Consult the source for exact classes of recommendation and levels of evidence.
guidelines.verification_status: Bibliographic record verified; recommendation-level abstraction pending

guidelines.title: 2023 Focused Update of the 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure
guidelines.summary: Focused European heart failure guideline update incorporating pivotal HFpEF/HFmrEF evidence. Consult the primary text for exact recommendations.
guidelines.verification_status: Bibliographic record verified; recommendation-level abstraction pending

guidelines.title: 2023 ACC Expert Consensus Decision Pathway on Management of Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction
guidelines.summary: HFpEF-focused expert consensus and diagnostic/management pathway; distinct from a formal graded clinical practice guideline. Consult the source for individual statements.
guidelines.verification_status: Bibliographic record verified; recommendation-level abstraction pending
